_comment: What the catalog MCP server returns for the story (normalised; Jira shape). Fictional data for docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md.
description: As a customer I want to pay with PayPal on the payment step so that I don't have to type my card details.
acceptanceCriteria: The Payment page has a 'Payment method' choice: Card (default) or PayPal.
Choosing PayPal hides the card fields; the button reads 'Continue with PayPal'.
After approving on PayPal the customer returns to Review Order, which shows 'Paid with PayPal' instead of the masked card.
Card payments behave exactly as before.
